statement: Legacy PR #232 records a bounded papañca review: MN 18 and Snp 4.11 support early process/conflict relations, while the formula identifying papañca with taṇhā, diṭṭhi, and māna is treated as later exegetical material rather than silently retrojected as an explicit early-discourse definition.

provenance.note: Preserved as evidence of the legacy argument; not an active doctrinal claim.
